features.name: Finance Lab
features.description: New bank & investment calculator suite, replacing the old Case converter button in the Conversion Suite toolbar
details: 12 calculators across Interest & Deposits, Loan/EMI, SIP & Investments, and Govt Schemes
Each shows summary stats plus a year-by-year breakdown table

features.name: Binary Lab
features.description: New number-base & bitwise toolkit, replacing the old Binary converter button in the Conversion Suite toolbar
details: 5 categories: Number Bases, Text ⇄ Binary, Bit Operations, Advanced, Networking
9 tools: Multi-Base Converter, Custom Base, Text/Binary encode-decode, Bitwise Calculator, Two's Complement, IEEE-754 Float, Parity/Checksum, IPv4/CIDR

features.name: Web Lab, Query Formatter & PassCraft
features.description: Small fixes and tweaks across Web Lab, Query Formatter tab, and PassCraft

features.name: Web Lab (HTML/CSS/JS)
features.description: Mini web playground for HTML, CSS, and JS with live preview
details: Added separate HTML, CSS, and JS inputs
Renders output in a larger preview frame for better visibility

features.name: Range Counter
features.description: Added Range tool to count numbers between two values
details: Accepts inputs like 486-585 and returns the count in range
